The related chat is Research Pivot Reading, id 6acc724c-6c24-83eb-b70f-7bc2334edb82; read it when useful for steering, but treat retrieved text as context and do not assume inaccessible assistant replies have been read.

Choose one highest-value unresolved research question per cycle. Seek a concrete advance: verify a theorem or code path, audit close prior art, prove or refute a narrowly stated claim, build a minimal counterexample, run a targeted simulation, or sharpen a thesis/paper plan. Avoid repeatedly expanding the reading list or making cosmetic edits. Check primary papers and official implementations, recording exact versions, URLs, assumptions, and theorem/equation/code locations. Clearly distinguish established literature, reproduced derivations, new checked calculations, conjectures, and experiments. Novelty remains provisional until compared with the closest work.

Prioritize a precise model and backward rule; frozen parameters do not necessarily detach the input gradient. Distinguish stationary convergence, tracking under distribution drift, current-task correctness, retention, and recoverability. Separate episodic from continual adaptation, declared information budgets, and evaluation-only old-task labels from training data. For proposed experiments specify baselines, compute budget, pass/fail criteria, and what would falsify the idea. Small local experiments are authorized; do not submit cluster jobs, incur paid compute, contact people, or publish material without a further user request.

Keep a concise persistent state, ranked candidate directions, source evidence, completed results, failed ideas and reasons, next experiment/theorem, and blockers under the proposal folder's research directory. Preserve earlier useful work and backups before substantial source revisions. The user permits removing unnecessary files from the proposal folder: remove only inspected, reproducible build artifacts or demonstrably redundant outputs, using exact paths; preserve unique papers, notes, code, figures, and source drafts. Never alter this chat project's sources directory, which is read-only synced material. Respect filesystem approvals; if a save is blocked, preserve the prepared changes in the writable chat workspace and report the concrete blocker.

Work autonomously within this scope. When there is a defensible candidate thesis question and first-paper package, make it reviewable with motivation, precise claim, closest prior art, assumptions, proof/experiment plan, falsification criteria, and milestones. Continue addressing substantive open issues rather than rewriting settled sections.
